x: After running a race I am reminded of Footer, shaken by coughing after a training run, erasing his name from the Southern team. Glen Cunningham has retired at last to take up the post of physical director at a small college in Iowa.

This time was three seconds faster than Wooderson's schoolboy record, and compares favourably with the schoolboy times of American stars, such as Cunningham's 4m. 24.7s., MacMitchell's 4m. 21.1s., Dodds' 4m. 28.4s., Lash's 4m. 30.5s., and Zamperini's 4m. 21.2s.
